SENSEX SLIDES AS NIFTY DIPS BELOW 25,400

The domestic equity markets opened lower on Friday, with the Sensex down about 376 points and the Nifty trading below the 25,400 mark. BSE Power dropped 1.36% while metal and realty stocks added to the decline.
Weak global market cues pressured Indian shares, making the broad market move notable for investors tracking overall sentiment.

For information only. Not investment advice.
